title: 高二短对话：档案与屋顶
source_notice: 高二银川标题公开阶段卷五短对话两遍/末尾十秒已核，不移借高一单遍。源录音/脚本/听力键缺，后文阅读1—5答案不能移作听力键；原校身份未认证。本稿完整原创配套非来源gold或独立难度验证。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听后留10秒。本机可重播供审阅，不作正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The archive says the photographs are free to view. Why did you pay twelve pounds?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I did not pay to see them. I ordered high-resolution copies for the exhibition. The charge was for making those files.

questions.stem: What did the man pay for?
questions.rationale: A：观看免费；B：不是参展报名费；C：明确为高分辨复制文件付费

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You finished the roof repair quickly. Did you replace all the tiles?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Only the broken ones. Most were sound, so throwing them away would have been wasteful.

questions.stem: Why did the woman keep most tiles?
options: The old ones were still usable.
She wanted to avoid climbing the roof.
questions.rationale: A：未说买不到新瓦；B：明确多数完好；C：已经完成屋顶维修

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I expected the lecture to be difficult, but the speaker used everyday examples.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, though I wish she had left more time for questions. That was the part I was most looking forward to.

options: There was too little time for questions.
questions.rationale: A：未因不熟主题失望；B：用了日常例子；C：明确wish更多问答时间

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Is your new team getting along?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We disagree often, but people explain why. It takes longer to decide things, yet the final plans are usually better than my first ideas.

questions.stem: How does the woman view the disagreements?
questions.rationale: A：争论后方案更好；B：未否定团队价值；C：讲清理由不代表没准备

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Shall we print five hundred copies of the programme?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We only sold two hundred tickets last year. Let us start with three hundred and print more if bookings rise.

questions.rationale: A：不赞成最初500；B：建议先印300视预订追加；C：仍印节目单非取消
